data.headline: Technology Executive | Product & Engineering Leadership | AI Innovation
data.about: Strategic technology executive with extensive experience in driving engineering excellence, scaling organizations, and aligning technical vision with business goals. Skilled in driving revenue growth, optimizing profitability, and overseeing P&L responsibilities and large-scale budgets. Demonstrated success in building high-performing teams, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and delivering measurable business outcomes. Expertise in AI and digital innovation, customer-centric product development, and organizational transformation from startup to scale-up stages. Adept at balancing technical leadership with financial accountability to drive sustainable growth and shareholder value.

description.text:
As VP, Product Engineering, I drive the strategic direction, operational excellence, and talent development of a distributed engineering organization. As a member of the Core Executive Team, I collaborate on defining company strategy, direction, and annual plans. My focus is on aligning technical strategies with business objectives, scaling engineering operations, and fostering innovation in an evolving AI landscape.
I lead all Product Engineering teams, including Core Product, Payroll, Financial Services, Employee Experience (mobile apps), and Product-Led Growth teams.

Key Responsibilities:

Engineering Vision and Strategy
Startup to Scale-Up Transformation
Leadership and Talent Development
AI Integration
Operational Efficiency
Strategic Alignment
Organizational Scalability

Highlighted Achievements:
Accelerated Delivery & Productivity: Overhauled R&D operations, resulting in a significant increase in quarterly product feature delivery and measurable improvements in customer impact.
Career Framework Implementation: Designed and implemented new engineering career paths, improving team structure and talent quality.
AI-Driven Innovation: Led the adoption of AI tools internally and launched AI-powered product features
Quality Transformation: Modernized quality strategies by replacing manual testing bottlenecks with automation testing frameworks and quality mindset within engineers, leading to faster release cycles and reduced defects.
Customer-Centric Engineering: Embedded a customer-first mindset across engineering teams, resulting in stronger feedback loops and products better aligned with customer needs.
Leadership Development: Coached and mentored senior engineering leaders, driving improved team performance and cultivating a high-impact leadership culture.
Cross-Functional Initiatives: Sponsored company-wide programs such as Hackathons and customer empathy exercises, bridging connections between R&D and business teams to foster collaboration and innovation

As Chief of Staff to the CTO, I drive productivity, efficiency, and happiness across engineering teams, delivering impactful product and business outcomes. Leading 200 employees and overseeing a 3000+ engineering organization, I serve as a trusted advisor to the CTO and partner with R&D executive leadership.

Responsibilities:

Engineering Health and Quality: Enhance performance, resiliency, code quality, and developer experience company-wide.
Internal Product Development: Lead R&D teams developing internal products for project management, customer support, revenue & sales, and talent management.
R&D Enablement: Drive onboarding, learning, communications, external community, and early talent programs.
Engineering Program Management: Establish structured engineering program management practice and build the team, develop director-level leadership.
Strategic Initiatives: Collaborate with C-suite to drive company-wide strategic initiatives.
Talent and Resource Management: Manage hiring pipeline, resource allocation, attrition, and performance.

Highlighted Achievements:
Launched quarterly business reviews, improving team health, PR review times, bug debt, quality, and resiliency.
Operationalized a global hiring pipeline, signing >50 high-quality candidates/week at peak and later shifting focus to low-volume, high-quality, talent density.
Drove talent density improvements through performance management methodologies and training, brand new career paths for engineering, attrition management, strategic prioritization, and resource allocation.
Launched Flexcomp, Shopify’s revamped compensation system, in <6 months.
Enhanced R&D enablement programs, increasing time to impact of new hires, increased engagement in tenured employees, and drove technical and mission alignment across company

Build and lead the engineering program management team and practice. Engineering Program Managers at Shopify are highly technical, high-leverage leaders who ensure the fundamentals of our core platform meet our high standards - its trust, speed, scale, stability, and consistency. Working in partnership with product and engineering to drive our most critical technical and product missions to success.

I lead technology for Shoppers Drug Mart’s digital business, leading teams to deliver customer value with speed, scale, and sustainability. My portfolio includes Shoppers’ eCommerce site, Digital Pharmacy, and the Shoppers Drug Mart mobile apps, as well as back-end services for Loblaw’s Covid Vaccine Digital Solution.

I am accountable for the performance, growth, and health of the development teams, for successful product delivery and operationalization, and our long-term technology strategy. 
As part of the core leadership team for SDM Digital, I work in partnership with Product, Trading, and Marketing to define our vision, digital strategy, and the tactics for our annual plan. 

• Launched SDM’s Front Shop initiative, transforming our eComm business from a Beauty retailer to a one-stop shop for Canadians’ personal essentials, beauty, and health. 
• Led back-end services for Loblaw’s Covid Vaccine Digital Solution, which facilitates vaccine administration including inventory, capacity, registration, booking, administration and adjudication. This solution was built and released in a period of 9 weeks, to allow pharmacies to start vaccinating Canadians.
• Leading a product transformation of our Digital Pharmacy product, from a digital refill solution, to a patient-centric end-to-end digital pharmacy with a holistic health journey
• Built and launched a DE&I strategy for technology at LD, with a holistic approach to solving diversity challenges and inequities in tech, along with improving current gaps in our processes. This includes, but is not limited to, a targeted mentorship and sponsorship program, role description reviews, promotion process transparency and standardization, team retrospectives, hiring process overhaul, and a DEI scorecard.
• Established people-centric initiatives, such as 360 reviews, recognition frameworks, structured growth and performance management, to increase team engagement and satisfaction

As Head of Client Services at TWG, my mandate is to build deep and long-lasting partnerships with clients, with a focus on continuous value delivery to enable our customers’ business goals. 

As part of TWG’s core executive team, I work with our leaders and across departments on our company strategy, vision and execution, and communication. 

I am accountable for profitability across all our services, revenue generation from our managed accounts, and client satisfaction across the board. 

I lead revenue generation, and am accountable for revenue protection, of 70% of TWG’s revenue, across all our managed accounts

• Grew key account revenue by 78% in FY19, and 52% in FY20 to date
• Grew average account size to $500K in FY20, and $350K in FY19, up from $250K in FY18
• Introduced margin measurement and standardization, and increased profitability by 27%
• Partner with the CTO on delivery oversight, managing project health and work quality, and risk mitigation and issue management across projects
• Built a Digital Innovation partnership with Amazon Web Services Canada
• Go-to-market & sales enablement, including top-of-funnnel lead generation, services development and positioning
• Sales operations and leadership, proposals and RFP response development, contract development and negotiation


One of my goals is to instill customer obsession, client empathy, and client services aptitude culturally across the organization, and in every TWG employee

In this role, I built TWG’s account management and client services practice from the ground up. I focused on bridging delivery leadership and oversight with client satisfaction and profitability, and managing change, risk, and employee health and satisfaction, as I introduced new processes and mandates into existing structures.

This included - 
• Building and systematizing key account management structures across TWG
• Customer segmentation and a model for high-potential, managed accounts
• Managing account investment and optimizing for ROI from key accounts
• Hiring, leading, and coaching a team of delivery leaders and account directors
• Introduced measurement of account health, client satisfaction, and profitability
• Reporting on accounts, wins, and issues across the organization
• Systematized operations and reporting across engineering, product, design, and sales departments

TWG is a digital product studio headquartered in Toronto and expanding operations to India. I led the global expansion to build, grow, and operationalize TWG's India team and open an office in Mumbai. This included hiring, team management, and all operations.

At Rangle, I led a cross functional team of 30 software developers, product and delivery managers, designers, and QAs, building and coaching high performing teams. 

I managed a portfolio of 6-10 accounts, and ~$10MM in revenue annually, and worked closely with our clients, to align our product development efforts with their business goals and build long-term successful partnerships.

In this role, I was accountable for -  
• Team management and growth. Including hiring, career development, resourcing, and billable utilization of my unit
• Reliable, profitable, and high quality product delivery across my account portfolio
• Client Satisfaction
• Partnering with our Client Services organization, enabling account growth and revenue generation
• Sales and Solutioning activities, including account mining, lead generation and development, RFPs and proposals, SOWs and contract negotiation

At Arcurve, I was a senior consultant working with enterprise oil & gas clients, as a project manager, business analyst, account manager, and delivery leader. 

In this role, I -
• Managed $6M - $8M annually in services revenue
• Led cross-functional agile teams across a broad spectrum of business domains, scope and technology stacks
• Managed account portfolios, leading development and growth of client relationships
• Managed organizational resourcing and allocations
• Managed my cross-functional team of ~20, including hiring, performance management, career growth, and mentorship
• Partnered with our sales team to develop proposals, SOWs, and assist bottom-of-funnel business development activities

QA lead for a project developing and maintaining a legacy application in the oil and gas domain, with a team of 12 developers

Managed an offshore testing vendor, coordinating their effort, priorities, timelines and deliverables.

Developed plan and led testing with clients for UAT, beta and usability test cycles.

Developed the test plan, and maintained it to be up to date with changing scope, features, schedule and priorities

Led the QA process and activities of the scrum team at all levels of the software development life cycle.

Requirements analysis and solution design, functional requirements documentation, test planning, test case authoring and execution, bug tracking and management
